The '''stole of the Keeper of the Chronicles''' is a symbol of office for the [[Aes Sedai]] in the position of [[Keeper of the Chronicles]]. It is a strip of fabric in the color of the wearer's [[Ajah]], worn over her dress, hanging from behind her neck and down her torso. The width of the stole is decided by the Keeper.{{ref/book|0|2}}
